commands.review_summary:
The PR changes Worker Hetzner provisioning and fleet cleanup so readiness-failed servers and newly created lease-owned SSH keys are rolled back or persisted for deferred cleanup, with LeaseRecord fields and focused Worker tests.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection of current main shows a Hetzner readiness failure can occur after server creation while the failed lease lacks cleanup-addressable cloudID/serverID; I did not run a live Hetzner allocation in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Human follow-up is needed because automation cannot supply the contributor's live Hetzner account proof or make the maintainer call to accept mocked validation only.

target.title: fix(worker): roll back partial Hetzner provisioning
target.body:
## Summary

- roll back a Hetzner server when post-create readiness fails, treating already-absent resources as successfully cleaned up
- continue through retryable server-type fallbacks after a successful rollback
- delete only newly created canonical lease-owned SSH keys; retain shared workspace, reused, and custom keys
- persist exact key cleanup work when immediate deletion fails, retry it with coordinator backoff, and finish it before workspace reprovisioning
- persist the exact server and key IDs when rollback deletion fails, defer cleanup without hot-looping, and retry server-before-key so an attached key is never removed first
- honor an explicit no-delete release by retaining pending exact server/key cleanup without alarms, while preserving a later explicit delete path

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/761

## Verification

Current exact head: `1d8cdcd4` (rebased onto current `main`). Exact-head CI is running.

- `npm test --prefix worker` — 774 tests passed
- `npm test --prefix worker -- --run test/fleet.test.ts` — 357 tests passed
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run build --prefix worker`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh` — 52 command docs, 70 providers, 204 Markdown files, and the generated docs site
- autoreview found and drove a workspace server-ID persistence fix; the follow-up review reported no actionable findings

No new live Hetzner canary was run because the saved token does not authenticate. The regression suite exercises successful rollback, server and key 404 idempotency, fallback continuation, durable ordinary and workspace server/key ID recovery after rollback failure, server-before-key cleanup, exact-ID persistence/retry, retry backoff and early-alarm suppression, shared/reused-key retention, explicit no-delete retention for server+key and key-only states, workspace alarm quiescence, and later explicit deletion.
